title: Tome Imbuement
description: Create Quark Tomes in Illager Invasion's Imbuement Table
body:
# Tome Imbuement

Allows the usage of [Illager Invasion](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-invasion)'s Imbuing Table to create [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark)'s Ancient Tomes.
Tomes can only be made with enchantments that are in BOTH the `illagerinvasion:imbuing` enchantment tag and the Quark validEnchants config.

![preview.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Partonetrain/tomeimbuement/refs/heads/main/preview.png)

Additionally, there is a config option to restrict the Imbuing Table to this functionality.
